optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Data Platform Migration

experienceHighlights.text: Ran the migration's five workstreams under the company's delivery method, including the migration plan and cut-over schedule.
experienceHighlights.witness: Technical project manager on the data platform migration of a software company for two years, running the migration's five workstreams under the company's delivery method with the migration plan and the cut-over schedule.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of data platform.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the weekly steering report for the head of data platform, filed with the steering decisions in the migration folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed dependencies with four data engineering teams and three analytics teams through the method's dependency register.
experienceHighlights.witness: Managed the dependencies with the four data engineering teams and the three analytics teams through the method's dependency register, escalating two blocked dependencies to the steering meeting.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared cut-over readiness reviews for eleven cut-overs, recording the head of data platform's approval and delineating responsibilities.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the cut-over readiness review for each of the eleven cut-overs; the cut-over approval was the head of data platform's, recorded on the readiness review, which also records which checks were mine and which the engineering teams'.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote closure reports for each workstream, including workstream boundary statements and acceptance evidence signed by analytics team leads.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the closure report for each workstream with the workstream boundary statement and the acceptance evidence signed by the analytics team leads.
